ja308:1.1: Akaramhase te kiccaṃ yaṃ balaṃ ahuvamhase, (cfr. Dhp. p. 147,1) migarāja namo ty-atthu, api kiñci labhāmase.
ja308:2.1: Mama lohitabhakkhassa niccaṃ luddāni kubbato dantantaragato santo taṃ bahuṃ yaṃ hi jīvasīti.
ja308:3.1: Akataññuṃ akattāraṃ katassa appatikārakaṃ yasmiṃ kataññutā n' atthi niratthā tassa sevanā.
ja308:4.1: Yassa sammukhaciṇṇena mittadhammo na labbhati anusuyyam anakkosaṃ sanikaṃ tamhā apakkame ti.
